evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/comparison/ComparisonView.tsx:151-153 — handleExportPDF() is a shipped no-op stub: its entire body is a comment `// In a real implementation, this would generate a PDF` (:152) followed by `showToast('PDF export coming soon!', 'info')` (:153). It is wired to a visible, always-enabled `Export PDF` <button> at :212-227 on the public property-comparison page (Epic 51 / Story 51.3). A user who clicks Export PDF gets a 'coming soon' toast and nothing else — an advertised feature that does nothing in production.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/components/comparison/ComparisonView.tsx — the whole component ships with ZERO i18n (grep: 0 occurrences of useTranslations/next-intl in the file), so its user-facing copy is hardcoded English on a portal that serves sk/cs/de/en: the button labels `Share` (:210 area) and `Export PDF` (:227), plus the share/export toasts `'Comparison link copied to clipboard!'` (:145), `'Share this URL: <url>'` (:147) and `'PDF export coming soon!'` (:153). Non-English visitors on the comparison surface see raw English.

Fix: either implement PDF export (client-side generator or a reality-server endpoint) or hide/disable the Export PDF button until it exists — a shipped button that only toasts 'coming soon' is an incomplete feature reachable in prod, not a placeholder. Separately, route ComparisonView through next-intl `t()` for the Share/Export button labels and the three toasts. Distinct from the prior realtor-profile-mock-data finding (that was mock DATA on the realtor profile; this is a dead ACTION + i18n gap on the comparison view).

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/realtor/listings/[id]/edit/page.tsx — this is a `[locale]`-routed page in a next-intl app (sk/cs/de/en) yet imports NO translation API (grep: 0 useTranslations/getTranslations/next-intl) and hardcodes English throughout: heading `Edit listing` (:74), subtitle `Update the details of your listing.` (:75), `Loading listing…` (:81), `Missing listing id.` (:68), and the two API-failure fallbacks `'Could not load listing.'` (:42) and `'Could not save listing.'` (:61). Every non-English realtor editing a listing sees English chrome and English error copy.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/account/listings/[id]/edit/page.tsx — the owner-side edit wizard has the mirror-image defect: it hardcodes SLOVAK error fallbacks instead of routing through i18n — `'Načítanie inzerátu zlyhalo.'` (:166) on load failure and `'Uloženie zlyhalo, skúste znova.'` (:213) on save failure. On this locale-routed page a de/en/cs owner hits a failure and gets Slovak text. So across the two listing-edit surfaces the same UC is un-localised in two opposite directions (English on realtor edit, Slovak on account edit).

Fix: wrap all user-facing copy + error fallbacks on both edit pages in next-intl `t('…')` keys (the sibling listing/detail and contact surfaces already do this). Distinct from the prior profile-pages-i18n-gap / profile-hardcoded-locale findings, which covered the realtor/account PROFILE pages — the listing-EDIT pages are separate files not previously reviewed.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/price-map/page.tsx — a `[locale]`-routed page that DOES call `useTranslations('pages.priceMap')` (:40) but still renders large blocks of hardcoded Slovak that bypass i18n. The property-type filter chips come from a module-level `PROPERTY_OPTIONS` array with literal Slovak labels `'Všetky' / 'Byty' / 'Domy' / 'Pozemky'` (:29-34) and are rendered raw as `{opt.label}` at :189. The insights cards use hardcoded Slovak labels/trends built in the useMemo (:54+) — e.g. `'Priemerná cena / m²'`, `'Najdrahšia lokalita'`, `'Najväčší rast'`, `"<n> lokalít"` — and are rendered raw at :508/:521. cs/de/en visitors see Slovak labels on an otherwise-localised page.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/price-map/page.tsx:37 and :96 — number formatting is pinned to the Slovak locale regardless of the active route locale: `formatPrice` does `Math.round(v).toLocaleString('sk-SK')` (:37) and the listings-count insight does `totalListings.toLocaleString('sk-SK')` (:96). Digit grouping/format is therefore always Slovak (e.g. non-breaking-space grouping) for de/en/cs users; the currency glyph `€` is also hardcoded in the same template. Should use the active `locale` (via next-intl `useLocale()` / `Intl.NumberFormat(locale, …)`) as PriceAlerts.tsx already does.

Fix: move PROPERTY_OPTIONS + insight labels into the `pages.priceMap` message catalog and resolve them through `t()`, and thread the active locale into `toLocaleString` / `Intl.NumberFormat` instead of the literal 'sk-SK'. Distinct from prior reality-web i18n findings (crm-import, saved-search, profile pages, agency-import, protectedroute) — the price-map page is a separate, previously-unreviewed surface, and this finding additionally covers a locale-pinned number-format bug, not just untranslated copy.
